title: c-VEP and Burst-VEP dataset from Castillos et al. (2023)
description: EEG dataset from 12 healthy participants performing an offline 4-class code-modulated visual evoked potential (c-VEP) reactive BCI task. The study compared novel burst c-VEP sequences with traditional m-sequences at 100% and 40% amplitude depth, evaluating classification accuracy, calibration requirements and user experience. Recordings used a 32-channel BrainProducts LiveAmp system at 500 Hz, and classification used a convolutional neural network.
methods_description: Twelve participants focused on cued targets in a factorial design (burst vs m-sequence, 100% vs 40% amplitude depth) on a 60 Hz monitor with PsychoPy. EEG was recorded at 500 Hz from 32 active electrodes (BrainProducts LiveAmp, reference FCz). A CNN with spatial, temporal and 2D convolution layers decoded 250 ms sliding windows, with 1-6 calibration blocks and Pearson correlation for target selection.
